title: Transient SLO reserve orchestrator and regional replication raceback hotfix
author: Arjun Malhotra
description: Motivation: We observed two incidents where short-lived regional spikes triggered wholesale tenant evictions because SLO enforcement consumed tenant credit abruptly and synchronous KV replication races caused stale penalty state to persist across nodes. This PR introduces a transient SLO reserve orchestrator (per-tenant decaying credit pool with soft-shed rules) plus a small hotfix to the regional KV replication path that prevents raceback of penalty counters. Summary: 1) Add a transient_slo_reserve service that maintains a short-duration credit buffer per tenant, decays credits over a configurable half-life, and can be consulted by the SLO enforcer to allow short bursts without triggering eviction. 2) Implement a soft-shed policy that temporarily lowers batching windows and switches to cached responses for non-critical endpoints when reserve is exhausted instead of evicting. 3) Introduce an idempotent apply and fencing token in the region_kv_replicator to avoid a race where a delayed replicate could reapply an old penalty delta (the hotfix). 4) Add feature flag (ff.slo_reserve_v1) and rollout plan (canary regions -> global). Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-1289) - [x] Unit tests for decay calculator - [x] Integration tests for soft-shed behavior under load - [x] Hotfix test for replication fence - [x] Observability: metrics and traces added for reserve hit/miss, shed-rate, replication-fence events - [x] Feature flag gating and canary rollout notes Commits summary: - c4a7b9a: add transient_slo_reserve service and API contract - d2956f1: soft-shed orchestration and SLO enforcer integration - a58e0ff: region_kv_replicator: add fence token and idempotent apply, add tests - b121a2d: observability, docs, and feature flag wiring Changed areas (high level): - services/slo/reserve_manager.go: core decay logic and in-memory backing - services/slo/orchestrator.go: soft-shed and reserve checks integrated into enforcer path - infra/region/kv/replicator.go: fencing and idempotent apply hotfix - api/flags/feature_flags.yaml: new ff.slo_reserve_v1 flag - telemetry/metrics/slo_metrics.go: reserve_hit/reserve_miss and shed_rate telemetry - docs/operational/slo_reserve.md: operator runbook and rollout steps - tests/integration/slo_reserve_smoke_test.go and tests/replicator_fence_test.go Review conversation (timeline condensed): - Maya Chen (reviewer): "Thanks, solid design. Two asks: (1) make decay half-life configurable per-deployment (not only compile-time), (2) please document the safety margins used when soft-shedding to avoid client-visible regressions." - Arjun (author): "Added config in services/slo/config.go and expanded runbook with safe default margins (50% latency headroom)." - Lina Ortega (reviewer): "We need a small guard in the enforcer to prefer throttling over cached responses for critical endpoints (billing/auth). Please add an allowlist." - Arjun: "Added allowlist and test coverage for critical endpoint behavior." - Evan Patel (reviewer): "Hotfix: replication fence looks fine, but add an assertion on persisted fence token to avoid future regressions." - Arjun: "Added persisted fence token and test that simulates delayed replica writes." CI summary: - unit: pass - lint: pass - integration: one flaky test (tests/integration/replicator_fence_test.go) failed on first run due to timing but passed after rerun - e2e load job: pass on canary config (single region) Merge and rollout: - Merge method: squash - Merged at: 2026-02-25 - Merge commit: squash of the feature branch into main - Rollout: ff.slo_reserve_v1 enabled in 2 canary regions for 24 hours, monitor reserve_hit/reserve_miss and eviction_rate. If stable, enable globally over 48h with automatic rollback key if eviction_rate rises >10% over baseline Observability and alerts added: - slo.reserve_miss_rate (per-tenant, per-region) - slo.shed_rate - replicator.fence_rejects - Alert: reserve_miss_rate > 5% sustained 15m in canary -> auto-disable feature flag Release notes: "Adds a transient SLO reserve that prevents transient spikes from causing tenant evictions and introduces a hotfix preventing regional replication races that could reapply historical penalty deltas. Feature is behind ff.slo_reserve_v1; canary rollout is scheduled. Operators: see docs/operational/slo_reserve.md for rollback steps." Deployment notes: - The change is backward compatible and gated by a feature flag; no DB migration required. - The replication fencing requires a small persisted token (string) per-region; the first rollout will write the initial token automatically. - Recommended canary: low-traffic regions with active SLO monitoring. Post-merge actions: - Monitor telemetry for 72h and be prepared to toggle ff.slo_reserve_v1 - Follow-up ticket: ENG-1354 to add a persistence-backed reserve snapshot for long restarts Edge cases and risk mitigation: - Risk: mis-sized decay halves may let bursts leak through; mitigated by conservative defaults and operator-facing config - Risk: soft-shed could affect downstream SLAs; mitigated by endpoint allowlist and gradual rollout - Risk: race conditions in replication; mitigated by fence token persisted and integration tests added Additional notes: This PR is intentionally kept to a minimal hotfix on the replicator to minimize scope; the larger persistence-backed reserve (ENG-1354) will be follow-up. For debugging: trace id header x-rw-trace will include reserve decisions and replicator fence events.
